title: Automating MedicaL Protocols with LargE Language Models: A Feasibility Study with HeaRt Team Protocols
summary: Treatment decisions for patients with valvular heart diseases and an increased risk of surgery are discussed in a local heart team. These meetings require the preparation of a heart team protocol based on the clinical data for each patient. The data collection is time-consuming, reducing the amount of time available for direct patient care. The automatization of heart team protocols, i.e. the aggregation of all relevant clinical data using artificial intelligence (AI), aims to optimise this time-consuming process. This project intends to reduce the workload of the medical staff, leaving more time for direct patient care.

interventions.name: Manual generation of heart team protocols (mHT protocols) by physicians based on clinical and paraclinical patient data as the basis for therapy decisions in the Heart Team; measurement of time and correctness of data transfer (baseline).

Artificial intelligence based heart team protocols (aiHT protocols), which are generated using large language models, based on clinical and paraclinical patient data as the basis for therapy decisions in the Heart Team; measurement of time and the number of correct entries (baseline).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with a valvular heart disease capable of providing informed consent that are also intended for a heart team consultation.
Exclusion criteria:
Patients incapable of giving informed consent
